configuration: Both upstream cases of unittest/geometry-model.cpp, manage_collision_pairs and test_clone. The deck is the ur5 robot description vendored with the pinned source at code/pinocchio/models/example-robot-data/robots/ur_description/, an arm of six revolute joints carrying seven triangle-mesh collision objects and one box, parsed by the URDF geometry parser exactly as upstream parses its own deck. Upstream runs this case on romeo_small.urdf from the romeo_description package, which is not vendored under code/pinocchio/; the ur description is, with its collision meshes, and it is the deck the module's own upstream example uses. The security margin the case applies to every pair, the two sphere radii the clone case uses and the placement of each collision object in its parent joint frame are read from ic/<ic>/operands.json; ic/nominal carries the values the parser produced and the upstream literals 1.0, 0.5 and 1.0 unchanged. Graded: the security margin and the distance upper bound that reach every collision request through setSecurityMargins in both triangles, the radii the deep copy and the shallow copy report after the original's shape is mutated, and the placement of every object of the cloned model.
observable: the clearance each collision pair is required to keep, and the placements and radii a cloned geometry model carries
default_vs_upstream: the ur5 description in place of romeo, and the security margin, the two radii and the geometry placements as initial conditions in ic/ rather than source literals and parsed constants
variant: Two units in the last place, toward positive infinity, on every nonzero number of ic/nominal/operands.json; the zeros are left as they are, because two ulps above zero is a subnormal, which is not a perturbation of a length, an angle or a quaternion coordinate. Perturbing every nonzero component rather than one component per quantity is deliberate: on an earlier Pinocchio leaf, moving a single entry of a rotation rounded away in an output built from all nine and left dozens of observables with a spread of exactly zero, while moving all of them is still a two-ulp calibration. Here that is the security margin, the two sphere radii and the twelve numbers of each of the eight geometry placements. 29 of the 89 numbers move; the other 60 are exact zeros. The worst measured spread over all 180 graded values is 4.4409e-16 absolute.
altbuild: none: the same source built at -O0 with -ffp-contract=off reproduces the -O2 -DNDEBUG result bit-identically for every graded value of this check, so an alternative build measures a floor of exactly zero and supplies no evidence. The graded quantities are rigid transform compositions and geometric distances between fixed shapes; Eigen fixes the evaluation order of the expressions, the loops are scalar, and coal's shape queries are closed form or an exhaustive minimum over a fixed set of features, so the compiler has nothing to reassociate. The alternative build was nevertheless run for every check of this leaf rather than assumed, because on an earlier Pinocchio leaf it was what exposed a graded buffer that was reading uninitialised memory.

evidence.floor_how: The same official.cpp compiled twice against the same pinned library, once at -O2 -DNDEBUG and once at -O0 -ffp-contract=off, and run on ic/nominal; every graded value was bit-identical, so the measured floor is 0.0 and the bound is set from the variant spread and the physics instead.

warrant: The graded quantities are the clearance in metres that each collision pair is required to keep as it reaches the narrow phase, indexed by the pair set the model enumerates in a fixed order; the radius in metres of the shape a cloned and a copied geometry model hold; and the placement of every object of the clone, in metres and in the model's Cartesian axes. The bound is 1e-09 absolute plus 1e-11 relative, so on the largest graded magnitude here, about 1.00e+00, it admits about 1.01e-09. It is physical because every implementation fault this case can express is many orders of magnitude larger: a security margin written into the wrong triangle of the map, or not propagated to the distance upper bound, changes a request by the whole margin, 1 m here, nine decades above the bound; a clone that shared its shapes reports the mutated radius, a difference of 0.5 m; and the upstream assertions on the pair mapping, the activation flags and the clone equality stay active, so such a fault is rejected twice over. It is achievable because a correct port that reassociates these compositions differs by about a few units in the last place of the largest intermediate, some 1e-15 in these units, six decades inside the bound, and because the alternative build measured exactly zero. Measured on this host: the two-ulp variant moves the worst graded value by 4.4409e-16, using 4.397e-07 of the bound, that is 2,274,318 times of headroom across all 180 graded values; and every graded value scaled by 0.1 per cent, a fault far smaller than any this test can express, is rejected at 990,099 times the bound. The bound is loose enough for a genuinely different implementation on another device and tight enough that no fault the upstream test is written to catch could pass it.
